short_description: A dynamic image captures a woman on a personal watercraft, speeding across choppy dark blue water. A massive, curling wave looms behind her, its crest breaking into white foam. The woman, dressed in a red and black wetsuit, has her hair dramatically swept back by the wind, and her expression is focused and determined. The watercraft leaves a trail of white spray, emphasizing its motion and the power of the surrounding ocean.
